name: Bulletin
desc: Newsprint: ruled rows, square corners, one spot of green.
_note: Ported from the bulletin design mockup: newsprint, one spot green,
rules instead of gaps, square corners. It shares `list` with aero and with
the default, and the three are not mistakable for one another -- rowGap 0
plus separators turns the same layout from floating cards into a ruled
table, which is the metric pair that exists for exactly this.
Selection is the ink itself, which is how print marks a line.
